# Personal-site identities and theme workbench

Owner-authorized app-kit work; source-only inspection of `geoff`, no website mutation,
install, deployment or consumer migration. [ADR-0029](../adr/0029-named-themes-and-app-owned-style-guides.md)
and the [guide](../design/theme-workbench.md) own intent and exact source mappings.

## Implemented

The owner selected older neon-white/pink/purple Synthwave as primary and retained the
newer gray/indigo dashboard as secondary. `geoff-synthwave` derives from committed older
CSS; `geoff-indigo` from the untracked Next migration. Existing `synthwave` stays distinct.
Both new presets provide 23 semantic color roles, declared fonts/radii, generated CSS,
Go embeds and revalidating handlers. Both are dark-only under every scheme request.
Source white/palette values are intentional exceptions; control ink, strong boundaries
and missing status roles are explicit semantic adaptations, not original site contracts.

Optional `NeonCSS()` is a static semantic-ink title glow. No font download, animation
or global heading/body rule; print, forced colors and increased contrast remove it.
No whole-site components, photos or dependencies were copied. A declared font stack
does not prove Inter loaded. Broader website patterns remain documented candidates.

The shared emitter now binds font/radius utilities through runtime variables alongside
color. Default resolved values remain; consumers rebuild old literal utilities once.
Gallery `/themes` previews four identities, four actual specimen groups and three
scheme requests, with independent effect selection/reset. It changes no app preferences.
`vendor --theme` selects one stylesheet and explicit checks reject a different requested
identity; without the flag, historical disk-versus-lock checking remains unchanged.
Catalog and `theme-workbench` MCP guidance expose availability and gaps.

## Evidence

- Tests compare all required roles, four CSS branches, generated bytes, declared fonts
  and selected text/control contrast pairs. HTTP tests cover GET/HEAD, ETag/304 and refusal.
- Workbench tests exercise 4 palettes × 4 specimens × 3 schemes, selected assets,
  preserved context, optional effects, invalid queries and no preference writes.
- A compiled Gallery CSS canary checks actual font/radius utilities use runtime references.
  Pinned Tailwind 4.3.0 rebuild passed; this is not only an emitter-string assertion.
- Independent review found substring query-key admission; exact comparisons and a
  `palette%7Ctheme` refusal regression now cover it.
- Race run passed: Gallery22.753s, tokens3.472s, Indigo3.339s, new Synthwave2.276s,
  existing Synthwave3.654s, catalog3.775s, CLI5.161s and MCP20.867s. Scoped vet passed.
- Fresh compiled Gallery on `127.0.0.1:18766` serves the workbench/new identities/catalog
  with HTTP200. The older port18765 process was not replaced.
- Post-document checks passed for terminal catalog, adoption and MCP; the scoped
  intent checker passed63 documents/377 links/29 ADRs/6 goals/7 futures. CUE validation
  and scoped whitespace checks passed. Historical long ADRs remain unchanged.

## Not earned

The in-app browser retry returned `Browser is not available: iab`. A later approved
[isolated Chrome smoke](2026-09-13-gallery-browser-smoke.md) records theme-page screenshots
and limited navigation, not exact font fidelity, full keyboard/accessibility or performance.
App-owned mounting/edit/diff/export now has separate [HTTP evidence](2026-09-13-app-owned-theme-review.md);
complete browser tasks and consumer migration/propagation remain G1/G4 work.
